json.description: Any JSON value, carried verbatim. Strings inside it are never references to other parts of the document.

description: The document's brushes. A stroke names a brush by `name` (`brush` of a stroke item); a reader that does not implement brushes draws the plain stroke.

brushes.description: An array of brush definitions as VectorCraft keeps them: each an object with `name` and `type` (`calligraphic`, `scatter`, `art`, `pattern` or `bristle`) and the parameters of that type; art-carrying brushes hold objects of the same shape as a layer's.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema: 1.

title: x.vectorcraft.brushes - VectorCraft's brush library
